constraints.rule_now: voxels only inside the 1 mm inset footprint and between the endplates (by construction)
constraints.harm_prevented: contact with spinal cord / dura (posterior), nerve roots in the foramen and vertebral artery (lateral, beyond the uncinate processes), oesophagus (anterior)
constraints.why: as-built position only; posterior margin to the canal is 1 mm with the PLL resected (DECISIONS_baseline_human_c34.md:19, 27). The loaded / migrated position is covered by S9 (posterior 0.5 mm). Insertion OVER-shoot (pushing the part too far posteriorly during impaction) is covered by nothing -> missing item M10.
constraints.recommended_value: inset 1.0 mm (unchanged) + the posterior edge must stay >= 0.5 mm anterior of the posterior vertebral wall in every loaded state (= S9 posterior limit)
constraints.range: posterior inset 1.0-1.5 mm; lateral / anterior 1.0 mm
constraints.plain_zh: 支架只能待在兩節頸椎之間的椎間盤空間裡，四周再往內縮 1 毫米。就像書要放在書架格子內、不能凸出：後面是脊髓，兩側是神經根和椎動脈，前面是食道。

constraints.rule_now: PLAN.md:28: slides along -X with transient disc-height gain <= 2 mm over native; hard PLCL strain <= 3 %, compliant <= 40 %; Y width <= anterior opening
constraints.harm_prevented: an implant that cannot be inserted without bone removal, is cracked / permanently deformed during insertion (debris near the cord, wrong final shape), or needs harmful over-distraction (facet overload, neck pain, subsidence, adjacent-segment change)
constraints.why: (1) 'slides along -X' with a strain number is not yet a computable test: no path, no envelope, no definition of 'hard' vs 'compliant' voxel (E(phi) saturates at phi 0.5, F-0009 item 6, so phi alone is ambiguous). (2) 3 % for hard PLCL is above the elastic limit in 3 of 9 material corners (15 MPa / 900 MPa = 1.67 %, 25/900 = 2.78 %, inter-layer 0.8 x 15/400 = 3.0 %; notes N2). (3) 40 % for PLCL 50:50 has no source: compression set / recovery of the printed elastomer at 37 C is unverified. (4) The transient limit 2 mm is borrowed from a FINAL disc-height study (Hsueh 2023: postop-preop >= 2 mm); no study gives a transient limit (notes N5). (5) Arithmetic (notes N1, N3): at T = 2.0 mm a contour-matched column still needs 14.7 / 21.4 / 27.2 % compression (d 0.5 / 1.0 / 1.5); a zero-strain hard core is limited to 2.95 + T = 4.95 mm; the tallest column then needs >= 2.1 / 3.4 / 4.6 mm of compliant (or void) height. (6) Reverse path = expulsion path (notes N4): a core cut to the anterior envelope keeps only ~0.35 mm midline overlap with the posterior lip at d 0.5 -> the concavity interlock largely disappears; S9 must be run with this in mind.
constraints.measurable: yes, as defined below: L0 geometric sweep (ms, CPU) + L1 static FE of the most-compressed pose (stress); no dynamic insertion simulation needed

recommended_value.definition_of_hard_and_compliant: compliant voxel = local E(phi) <= 20 MPa (i.e. in the elastomer range, E_soft high set 12 MPa x ~1.5); every other solid voxel is hard. Uses the agreed E(phi) law, not phi.
recommended_value.transient_distraction: parallel separation of the endplates at insertion T <= 2.0 mm over native at the disc centre (includes d); final d 0.5-1.5 mm (unchanged). Tilted (anterior-opening) distraction allowed only if the integrator shows facet-capsule / ligament forces at that pose do not exceed those of the 2.0 mm parallel pose (computed in the FSU model).
recommended_value.path: rigid-body path family checked at L0: straight -X; oblique -X rotated +/-15 and +/-30 deg in the X-Y plane; each with a free vertical (Z) offset per step. Pass if ANY path passes. Path step 0.2 mm (voxel size).
recommended_value.hard_core_rule: at every step of the path every hard voxel lies inside the gap between the C3 and C4 bony surfaces at distraction T (zero overlap, 0.1 mm clearance) -> zero hard strain by construction
recommended_value.compliant_rule: column-wise compression needed by compliant voxels = overlap / compliant thickness <= 30 % (default; range 20-40 %, raise to 40 % only after a compression-set test of printed PLCL 50:50 at 37 C wet shows >= 95 % recovery within 24 h). Then L1 static FE of the worst pose: von Mises in hard voxels <= 0.5 x local LOW strength (hard 15 MPa, inter-layer 12 MPa), no hard-soft interface tension above 0.5 x soft low strength (3 MPa).
recommended_value.opening: projected Y width of the part along the path <= anterior annulotomy chord (120 deg sector) - 1 mm; chord to be computed (s01_geometry.py, figure read ~11 mm, unverified)
recommended_value.report: per design: path used, T used, max compliant compression %, peak hard stress / low strength, estimated insertion force = mu 0.45 x sum of normal force at the worst pose (for the instrument)

constraints.range: T 1.5-2.5 mm (2.0 default until a surgeon confirms); compliant compression 20-40 %; hard stress ratio 0.33-0.67 of low strength
references: Hsueh LL, Yeh YC, Lu ML, Luo CA, Chiu PY, Lai PL, Niu CC 2023, Sci Rep, doi:10.1038/s41598-023-44998-4: over-distraction = postoperative minus preoperative index disc height >= 2 mm; subsidence 47 vs 31 % (p 0.04), radiological adjacent-segment pathology 48 vs 15 % (abstract read via Europe PMC 2026-10-27)

J Korean Neurosurg Soc 2013, 'Vertebral distraction during anterior cervical discectomy and fusion causes postoperative neck pain', https://www.koreascience.or.kr/article/JAKO201334460141077.pdf : Caspar distraction torque > 6.0 kgf cm gave more posterior neck pain (n 24); authors not verified
Mobi-C / Bryan technique notes as cited in DECISIONS.md 2026-10-26 (trial height not above healthy adjacent discs; minimise pin distraction, PMC6132602) - not re-opened this round
DECISIONS_baseline_human_c34.md:46-47, 115-116 (E and strength sets); notes N1-N4
constraints.plain_zh: 支架必須能從脖子前方一次整塊放進去，而且不能削骨頭。就像把床墊搬進一扇比床墊矮的門：硬的骨架必須本身就比門口（前方縫隙約 3 毫米，加上手術時暫時撐開最多 2 毫米）矮，完全不用壓；只有軟的部分可以被壓扁，最多壓掉三成，進去後再彈回來。這樣算下來，最高的中後段大多只能是軟材料或空洞。

constraints.harm_prevented: loose fragments migrating toward the cord or foramen
constraints.why: time-zero only; S2 compliant parts are compressed and slid against bone during insertion -> a thin soft flap can tear off (missing item M12); thin bridges weaken by hydrolysis over the 16-week support period
constraints.measurable: yes, L0 (connected-component labelling) + minimum bridge cross-section
constraints.recommended_value: one 6-connected component AND every bridge >= 0.8 x 0.4 mm (2 lines x 2 layers); compliant regions must be bonded to the hard core over >= 2 voxels thickness (no single-voxel soft flaps)
references: Wuisman PIJM, Smit TH 2005, Eur Spine J, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3489405
constraints.plain_zh: 支架必須是一整塊，不能有分開的小碎塊。就像一串鑰匙都要掛在同一個環上，掉下來的碎片可能跑到脊髓旁邊。軟的部分在插入時會被擠壓摩擦，所以要牢牢黏在硬骨架上，不能只連一點點。

constraints.rule_now: void connected to both endplates, >= 50 % of disc-space volume (PI 2026-10-26)
constraints.harm_prevented: loss of the purpose: no room and no nutrient path for the tissue-engineered biodisc
constraints.why: 50 % is a PI decision (no literature value). Volume alone can be met by a fine sponge (F-0009 item 7); the biodisc needs contact with both endplates for nutrition (endplate diffusion route; Urban, Smith, Fairbank 2004 Spine 29:2700, unverified this round) and a way to be placed into the void. S2 helps here: the tallest central region will mostly be void anyway (notes N3).
constraints.recommended_value: >= 50 % void volume (PI) AND void contact area >= 30 % of the footprint on EACH endplate AND minimum inscribed channel width >= 1.0 mm AND the void is open to at least one side for filling (or the PI states that the biodisc is pre-loaded before insertion - then it must survive the S2 compression)
constraints.plain_zh: 支架裡要留至少一半的空間給生物椎間盤長，而且空洞要同時貼到上下兩塊骨頭。就像花盆要有足夠的土，也要有底孔讓水進來：生物椎間盤靠骨頭表面滲入養分，空洞不能只是細細的海綿孔。

constraints.rule_now: min feature 0.4 mm X-Y, 0.2 mm layers, 45 deg overhang (build along Z)
constraints.harm_prevented: designs that cannot be printed or print with defects
constraints.why: single 0.4 mm line in a load path is fragile; inter-layer strength 0.8 x bulk (DECISIONS_baseline_human_c34.md:116) and the layers are parallel to the slip plane; elastomer overhang ability unverified
constraints.recommended_value: as PI decided (0.4 mm / 45 deg) PLUS load-path struts >= 0.8 mm (2 lines); soft (compliant) voxels overhang <= 30 deg until a print trial
constraints.plain_zh: 設計必須能用 3D 列印機印出來：線寬 0.4 毫米、每層 0.2 毫米、懸空不能斜過 45 度。就像疊積木，上一層不能伸出太多。承重的柱子建議至少兩條線寬，否則太容易斷。

constraints.harm_prevented: cage collapse under maximal neck effort
constraints.why: (1) 1164 N > mean endplate failure 1084 N (Schroder 2006) -> must be cage failure only, bone is S8. (2) Time zero only; support period is now set (>= 16 weeks, 26 sensitivity) but no degraded property set exists; PLCL 85:15 strength retention at 16 weeks 37 C: no data found this round (unverified). Lintz 2021: PLA cages softened in 37 C culture and ALL fractured at two posterior sites in 4 weeks (docs/PRIOR_FAILURES_Lintz2021.md). (3) Static only; Lintz failures were from repeated load -> fatigue (missing item M11).
constraints.measurable: time-zero yes (L2 compression); 16-week needs a degraded set (sensitivity: strength x 0.5, modulus x 0.7 until coupon data - assumption, unverified)
constraints.recommended_value: >= 1164 N before CAGE damage (low strength set) at time zero AND >= 1164 N with the 16-week degraded set; cite Moroney SP, Schultz AB, Miller JAA 1988 J Orthop Res 6:713
constraints.range: 800-1164 N (lower only if the PI accepts a collar / restricted activity)
references: Moroney et al. 1988 J Orthop Res 6:713-720
Schroder J et al. 2006 Cent Eur Neurosurg 67:188, doi:10.1055/s-2006-942279
constraints.plain_zh: 支架要撐得住約 1164 牛頓（約 119 公斤重）的壓力而不壞，這是用力繃緊脖子時頸椎承受的最大壓力。就像椅子要撐住一個人用力坐下。而且不能只看剛放進去的時候：材料在體內會慢慢變弱，16 週後也要撐得住。

constraints.harm_prevented: loss of distraction -> narrower foramen (nerve root) and loss of clamp force (fixation)
constraints.why: 150 N has no cited source (unverified); elastic only, no creep over 16 weeks (Lintz 2021: one-piece PLA cage lost 13.6-39.7 % disc height index in 4 weeks). S2 now pushes the tallest columns to be soft -> S7 becomes binding and must be checked on the real (S2-compliant) material layout.
constraints.measurable: elastic yes (L1/L2); creep no (no viscoelastic material in the model)
constraints.recommended_value: elastic loss <= d/2 at 150 N (keep) AND at the 16-week state (relaxed / degraded set) <= d/2
constraints.plain_zh: 在約 15 公斤重的壓力下，支架高度下降不能超過撐開量的一半。就像千斤頂撐住車子不能慢慢往下沉；高度一掉，神經出口變窄，支架也夾不緊。塑膠在體溫下會慢慢下沉，16 週後也要檢查。

constraints.rule_now: peak 1 mm2-averaged contact pressure below a subsidence proxy (calibrated on FEBio) - no number
constraints.harm_prevented: subsidence into the vertebral body; for this project also a contact hot spot that cracks the cage (Lintz posterior fractures)
constraints.why: no number, no load state -> not testable. A designer can fill the map without ever being checked.
constraints.measurable: yes, L1 contact pressure; L2 yielded-volume criterion (DECISIONS_baseline_human_c34.md:108-109)
constraints.recommended_value: peak 1 mm2-averaged pressure <= 5 MPa in all physiological states (100 N follower + 1.5 N m, 6 directions) and at 150 N; L2: yielded trabecular volume < 10 % within 3 mm
references: Cheng CC et al. 2007 Spine, doi:10.1097/BRS.0b013e31811ece5a
Morgan EF, Keaveny TM 2001 J Biomech 34:569
constraints.plain_zh: 支架壓在骨頭上的力量不能太集中，否則會像高跟鞋踩進草地一樣陷進骨頭。建議日常姿勢下，任何一平方毫米上的壓力不超過 5 百萬帕（約每平方公分 50 公斤重）。目前規則還沒有數字，無法檢查。

constraints.rule_now: mu 0.3 (0.2 / 0.45): cage-centre translation <= 1 mm vs C3 and C4, 6 directions x 3 cycles, no ratcheting; posterior net migration <= 0.5 mm and posterior push-out >= 135 N
constraints.harm_prevented: migration into the canal (cord injury) or anteriorly (oesophagus, loss of support) - main goal
constraints.why: (1) Posterior criteria are cord safety; checking them only at the nominal mu 0.3 accepts a design that fails at 0.2, which is inside the plausible range (polished surfaces on cancellous bone are at the low end: Rancourt 1990, Damm 2015; wet polymer: no data). (2) 'No ratcheting' over 3 cycles is not a number: give a per-cycle limit (see recommended). (3) Time zero only: clamp force relaxes in PLCL at 37 C over 16 weeks (magnitude unverified). (4) S2-compliant designs lose most of the concavity interlock (notes N4) -> S9 is where they will fail; the push-out test must include the ANTERIOR direction (the insertion path reversed) with the same transient-free state. (5) Push-out 135 N with friction only: 2 x mu x clamp -> needs a clamp >= 225 N at mu 0.3 or 338 N at mu 0.2 if no interlock (simple Coulomb, both faces); v2 runs had clamp 18-115 N (DECISIONS_baseline_human_c34.md:584-585) -> the posterior push-out floor will be very hard to meet without geometric interlock; flag to the PI, do not lower silently.
constraints.measurable: yes with the real-friction GPU solver once gates 2-5 pass (results/gpufe_verify/VERIFICATION.md: gate 2 only flexion passes, gates 3-5 pending) and L2 push-out
constraints.recommended_value: as PI decided, PLUS: posterior criteria (<= 0.5 mm, >= 135 N) must pass at mu 0.2; any-direction 1 mm at mu 0.3 (and reported at 0.2 / 0.45); ratcheting = net translation increment of cycle 3 <= 1 um per cycle in every direction (1 um x ~1e5 cycles in 16 weeks = 0.1 mm; cycle count unverified estimate); re-run S9 with clamp force x 0.5 as a 16-week sensitivity until creep data exist
references: Moroney et al. 1988 J Orthop Res 6:713 (AP shear up to 135 N)
Rancourt D et al. 1990 J Biomed Mater Res 24:1503, doi:10.1002/jbm.820241107
Damm N, Morlock M, Bishop N 2015 J Biomech 48:3517, doi:10.1016/j.jbiomech.2015.07.012
constraints.plain_zh: 最重要的一條：支架不能滑出來，尤其不能往後滑向脊髓。就像門擋要卡住門：往後最多只能動 0.5 毫米，而且要用比較滑的情況（摩擦係數 0.2）來檢查，寧可保守。每次轉頭若都滑一點點，幾個月累積下來也會滑出去，所以每一次的小滑動也要有上限。

summary_zh:
安全守門員第 2 輪結論（還沒有任何設計，只審查規則）：
1. 九條限制（S1 到 S9）都要保留。主持人上一輪採納了往後滑動上限 0.5 毫米、往後推出力至少 135 牛頓、支撐期至少 16 週、生物椎間盤空間至少一半。但檢查規則的程式（constraints.py）仍然不存在，上一輪提出的修改請求也沒有地方追蹤。
2. 本輪重點「從前方插入」（S2）：在不削骨頭的條件下，我把規則改寫成可以用電腦算的版本：手術時暫時撐開不超過 2 毫米；硬的骨架必須本身就能穿過前方最窄的縫隙（約 2.95 毫米加撐開量，即最高約 4.95 毫米），完全不必被壓；只有軟材料可以被壓，建議最多三成（目前寫四成，但沒有文獻或實驗支持）。原本寫的「硬材料可壓 3%」在九種材料假設中有三種會超過彈性極限，也就是會永久變形，所以建議改成以應力判斷。
3. 這個改寫帶來的後果：最高的中後段大多只能放軟材料或留空（剛好也可以當生物椎間盤空間）；而且能從前面進去的形狀，往後卡住的幾何也變少（中線只剩約 0.35 毫米重疊），所以防止往後滑向脊髓主要要靠摩擦和夾緊力。我建議往後方的安全檢查用比較滑的摩擦係數 0.2，而不是一般的 0.3。另外要提醒主持人：只靠摩擦要達到 135 牛頓推出力，夾緊力至少要 225 到 338 牛頓，但以前的模擬只有 18 到 115 牛頓，這一條很可能很難達到。
4. 暫時撐開上限：文獻沒有直接規定「手術中暫時撐開」的毫米數。現有證據是：最終椎間高度增加 2 毫米以上會提高下陷（47% 比 31%）與相鄰節段退化（Hsueh 2023）；撐開力過大會增加術後頸痛（韓國神經外科學會期刊 2013）。所以暫定 2 毫米，範圍 1.5 到 2.5 毫米，需請外科醫師確認。
5. 摩擦係數：仍找不到任何塑膠（PLCL、聚乳酸、聚醚醚酮 PEEK）直接在椎骨上的實測值；光滑金屬在骨頭上約 0.16 到 0.41。建議做小樣本摩擦實驗。
6. 新發現缺少的安全項目：(a) 插入時推太深碰到脊髓，需要有限深度的插入器械；(b) 實驗室以前的聚乳酸支架都在後方同兩處裂開，要加反覆受力（疲勞）檢查；(c) 軟材料插入時被骨頭磨破或與硬骨架剝離，碎屑可能跑到脊髓旁邊；(d) 16 週後材料變弱、夾緊力鬆弛，目前沒有任何檢查用到。
所有數值仍是建議，需主持人核准才會改動。本角色仍無法執行程式，數字是手算的，計算腳本已放在本角色資料夾，請其他角色執行核對。
